subject: Demolition Exercise - Juan de Fuca Strait
text:
Demolition Exercise - Juan de Fuca Strait
Military Exercise Areas WQ will be active for demolition exercises  from 1500 UTC NOV 5 until 0100 UTC NOV 6.
During operations Military Exercise Areas WQ is extremely hazardous and closed to marine traffic. 
Ref: NOTMAR F35 - Annual Edition
